rows.line: 僕に、なんて言うんだろうな、すごく大きな力をくれて
rows.en1: How do I put this...
rows.en2: What's the word...

rows.line: 僕にやらせてくださいみたいなことは、恐れ多くて言えなかった
rows.en1: I didn't have the nerve to ask.
rows.en2: Who was I to ask for that?

rows.line: これは後から聞いた話だと、
rows.en1: I only found this out later, but...
rows.en2: Turns out...

rows.line: それはもう、変な話、インする時というか
rows.en1: Weird thing to say, but...
rows.en2: Funny enough...

rows.line: やりたいんですって社長にもマネージャーにもずっと言ってた
rows.en1: I'd been telling everybody I wanted it.
rows.en2: I never shut up about it.

rows.line: 「ちょっとええか」つって言ったのが新幹線の中
rows.en1: Got a sec?
rows.en2: Hey, can I grab you for a minute?

rows.ja: なんなら〜してもいいぐらい
rows.line: なんならドキュメント番組で密着してもいいぐらい
rows.en1: Honestly, they could've filmed it for a documentary.
rows.en2: You could've made a whole doc out of it.

rows.line: せめて「マジか」って、自分の感情のまま声を出せる環境が良かった
rows.en1: I just wanted to be somewhere I could yell.
rows.en2: At least let me be somewhere I can freak out.

rows.line: せめて「マジか」って
rows.en1: No way.
rows.en2: Are you kidding me?

rows.ja: もう我慢できなかった
rows.line: もう我慢できなかったんだろうね
rows.en1: He just couldn't hold it in.
rows.en2: He couldn't wait any longer.

rows.ja: 〜を否定したいとかでもなくて
rows.line: 別に今を否定したいとか、過去を否定したいとかでもなくて
rows.en1: I'm not trying to knock how things are now or anything.
rows.en2: Not saying one's better than the other.

rows.line: いろんな制限がね、どうしてもかかってきちゃってる
rows.en1: There's just no way around all the rules.
rows.en2: The restrictions just keep piling up.

rows.line: 限界とは言いたくないけど
rows.en1: I don't want to call it my limit, but...
rows.en2: I'm not saying I've hit a wall, but...

rows.line: やってくと、色々考えちゃうっていうかね
rows.en1: You start overthinking stuff.
rows.en2: Your head starts spinning.

rows.line: もう本当になんかもう右も左もわかんないし
rows.en1: I had no clue what I was doing.
rows.en2: I didn't know up from down.

rows.line: 逆に言うと、怖さもないというか
rows.en1: Flip side is...
rows.en2: On the other hand...

rows.line: どうしていいかみたいなこと
rows.en1: that whole "now what?" feeling
rows.en2: not knowing what to do with yourself

rows.ja: 周りがどうとかじゃなくて
rows.line: 別に周りがどうとか、そういうことでもなくて
rows.en1: It's not about anybody else.
rows.en2: It's got nothing to do with other people.

rows.line: やっぱり出会いって大事だなと思うよね
rows.en1: It really comes down to who you meet.
rows.en2: The people you run into make all the difference.

rows.line: 一気に急に面白くなったりするから
rows.en1: All of a sudden it's fun again.
rows.en2: It just clicks and gets exciting.

rows.ja: 〜のはもちろん分かってるんだけど
rows.line: 安倍さんみたいになれないのはもちろん分かってるんだけど
rows.en1: I know I'll never be him, obviously, but...
rows.en2: I get that I'm not him, but still...

rows.ja: こういうもんなんだと思っちゃう
rows.line: へえ、こういうもんなんだと思っちゃうね
rows.en1: You just figure that's how it is.
rows.en2: You think, huh, guess this is normal.

rows.line: ちょっとした一言にすごく救われたりすることあるもんね
rows.en1: One little comment can really save you.
rows.en2: Sometimes one line is all it takes to pull you through.

rows.line: すっごい申し訳ない気になっちゃって
rows.en1: I felt so bad.
rows.en2: I felt like such a jerk.

rows.line: なんかこう、言い訳もできず
rows.en1: I couldn't even explain myself.
rows.en2: No chance to make an excuse.

rows.line: きさんは本当に何も飾らない
rows.en1: He's totally down-to-earth.
rows.en2: No airs at all.

rows.ja: 本当に何にもわかんない
rows.line: 本当に何にもわかんねっす、ごめんなさいマジで
rows.en1: Honestly, I have no idea. Sorry, seriously.
rows.en2: I've got nothing, man. Sorry.

rows.line: 内心は、なんか気を遣っちゃって
rows.en1: I end up tiptoeing around them.
rows.en2: I get all self-conscious.

rows.line: 生意気なこと言っておきよしって言われてる方が、全然楽
rows.en1: That's way easier for me.
rows.en2: I'd much rather have that.

rows.line: 全然楽。すっごいわかる
rows.en1: I totally get that.
rows.en2: Oh, a hundred percent.

rows.ja: そんなこと言ってらんない
rows.line: 今もそんなこと言ってらんないし
rows.en1: I can't be like that anymore.
rows.en2: That's not an option now.

rows.line: 最初の方、特にね、もうむずくて
rows.en1: It was so hard at first.
rows.en2: Man, the beginning was rough.
